accepted_conclusions: Signed-positive connected-sum identity d(J)=s(J)-sum_j span_a F_Qj and both target bounds for this class.
Nonempty finite split-union preservation of the Euler-characteristic bound, with disconnected surfaces and no closed components.
Explicit Ng/Torisu-supported family with positive degree and unbounded exact Kauffman-bound sharpness defect.
remaining_gaps: The Euler-characteristic inequality for arbitrary nonsplit links outside the proved class.
The unknotting-number inequality for arbitrary knots outside the signed-positive class.
